DISCUSSION AND OUTLOOK ---------------------- At 200 AM MST (0900 UTC), the center of Hurricane Rachel was located near latitude 19.4 North, longitude 111.8 West. Rachel is moving toward the west near 5 mph (7 km/h). A turn toward the west-northwest is expected today, along with a gradual increase in forward speed. Maximum sustained winds are near 90 mph (150 km/h) with higher gusts. Additional slow weakening is expected over the next day or two.
